name: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus
description: A devastating viral disease transmitted by whiteflies, causing severe stunting, yellowing, and leaf curling in tomato. It is one of the most damaging tomato diseases in tropical and subtropical regions, including West Africa.
symptoms: Leaf margins curling upward and inward
Leaflets becoming smaller with yellowing between veins
Young leaves showing chlorosis and distortion
Flower drop and reduced fruit set
Fruits that do develop are small and unmarketable
causes: High whitefly populations during dry periods
Infected tomato and weed hosts serving as inoculum sources
treatments: No curative treatment for viral infection
Remove and destroy infected plants immediately
Control whitefly vectors with neem oil or insecticidal soap
Use yellow sticky traps to reduce whitefly populations
prevention: Apply reflective mulches to repel whiteflies
Rogue infected plants as soon as symptoms appear
Remove weed hosts and volunteer tomato plants
Intercrop with tall crops like maize to reduce whitefly landing
